Info

CAD tool shape discretization, point sampling and hit-testing operations.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.gui.components.canvas_tool_handler.CanvasToolHandler[source]¶

Bases: object

Geometric discretization and spatial calculation engine for interactive CAD tools.

It defines:

methods:
discretize_line - Generates linear segment start and end waypoints.
discretize_circle - Generates circle perimeter waypoints.
discretize_rectangle - Generates 4 corner waypoints of rectangle boundary.
find_hit_index - Finds nearest waypoint index matching cursor hit-radius.
is_freehand_distance_met - Checks if cursor has moved beyond minimum freehand threshold.
classmethod discretize_circle(center: tuple[float, float], radius: float, steps: int, settings: CanvasSettingsDTO) → list[Waypoint][source]¶

Generates circle perimeter waypoints.

Parameters:

  • center – Center (x, y) coordinate tuple in mm.

  • radius – Circle radius in mm.

  • steps – Discretization step count.

  • settings – Active CanvasSettingsDTO.

Returns:

List of Waypoint instances.

Exceptions:

None.

classmethod discretize_line(p1: tuple[float, float], p2: tuple[float, float], settings: CanvasSettingsDTO) → list[Waypoint][source]¶

Generates start and end waypoints of straight linear segment.

Parameters:

  • p1 – Start point (x, y) coordinate tuple in mm.

  • p2 – End point (x, y) coordinate tuple in mm.

  • settings – Active CanvasSettingsDTO.

Returns:

List of Waypoint instances.

Exceptions:

None.

classmethod discretize_rectangle(p1: tuple[float, float], p2: tuple[float, float], settings: CanvasSettingsDTO) → list[Waypoint][source]¶

Generates 4 corner waypoints of rectangle boundary with closing start waypoint.

Parameters:

  • p1 – Initial corner (x, y) tuple in mm.

  • p2 – Opposite corner (x, y) tuple in mm.

  • settings – Active CanvasSettingsDTO.

Returns:

List of Waypoint instances.

Exceptions:

None.

classmethod find_hit_index(waypoints: Sequence[Waypoint], wx: float, wy: float, max_radius: float) → int[source]¶

Finds nearest waypoint index matching cursor hit-radius.

Parameters:

  • waypoints – Sequence of Waypoints.

  • wx – Cursor world X coordinate.

  • wy – Cursor world Y coordinate.

  • max_radius – Maximum hit-test radius in mm.

Returns:

Waypoint index or -1 if no hit.

Exceptions:

None.

classmethod is_freehand_distance_met(last_pt: Waypoint, wx: float, wy: float, min_dist: float) → bool[source]¶

Checks if cursor has moved beyond minimum freehand threshold.

Parameters:

  • last_pt – Last sampled Waypoint.

  • wx – Current world X.

  • wy – Current world Y.

  • min_dist – Minimum distance threshold in mm.

Returns:

True if distance met, False otherwise.

Exceptions:

None.
